  SELECT DISTINCT i.ref_id, i.prc
  FROM items_g2 i

  SUM(CASE WHEN cp.prc > ap.avg_prc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*),

) AS pct_above_avg

WITH cat_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.ref_id, i.prc
  FROM items_g2 i
  JOIN taxn_g2 t ON i.ref_id = t.ref_id
  WHERE t.cat_lvl = 1 AND t.cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND i.prc > 0
),
avg_price AS (
  SELECT AVG(prc) AS avg_prc FROM cat_products
)
SELECT ROUND(
  SUM(CASE WHEN cp.prc > ap.avg_prc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS pct_above_avg
FROM cat_products cp, avg_price ap;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_brands
FROM (
    SELECT pa.attr_val AS brand
    FROM fdbk_g3 f
    JOIN product_attributes_g3 pa ON f.ref_id = pa.ref_id AND pa.attr_key = 'Brand'
    WHERE f.review_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY pa.attr_val
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.review_year) = 3
) sub;

FROM (
    SELECT pa.attr_val AS brand
    FROM fdbk_g3 f
    JOIN product_attributes_g3 pa ON f.ref_id = pa.ref_id AND pa.attr_key = 'Brand'
    WHERE f.review_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY pa.attr_val
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.review_year) = 3
) sub;
